nonlinear_parameters: fix all 23 nonlinear parameters at released chain row 1101277 for every fit
linear_parameters: solve independently on the five training sectors in each band, then predict the omitted sector without resolving or updating any amplitude

implementation_contract.linear_solve: use lenstronomy image_linear_solve only to estimate the training-mask linear amplitudes
implementation_contract.heldout_prediction: after the solve updates the linear amplitudes, evaluate SingleBandMultiModel.image on the complete image plane; do not score the zero-filled masked array returned by image_linear_solve
implementation_contract.coordinate_delivery: instantiate every released or corrupted kwargs_data dictionary inside the scoring FittingSequence and verify each corruption changes at least one instantiated pixel-coordinate map

sector_geometry.coordinate_source: each uncorrupted released HDF5 coordinate dictionary as instantiated by lenstronomy ImageData.pixel_coordinates
sector_geometry.sector_index: floor((angle modulo 2*pi)/(2*pi/6)), giving sector 0 on [0,60 degrees) and half-open intervals thereafter
sector_geometry.application: hold out the same sky-angle sector simultaneously in F435W, F555W, and F814W; intersect with each released operative likelihood mask

predictive_metrics.variance: released lenstronomy model-dependent C_D_model plus absolute PSF model-error map
predictive_metrics.heldout_reduced_chi_square: sum of squared standardized residuals divided by heldout retained pixels; pool all three bands separately for each of six sector fits
predictive_metrics.coherent_residual: PSF-matched standardized-residual significance: correlate heldout z pixels with the normalized operative PSF and divide by sqrt of the heldout-mask correlation with PSF squared; inspect pixels with at least 80 percent of the full PSF L2 support

coordinate_controls.scalar_0p04: rescale each released 2x2 transform_pix2angle by 0.04/sqrt(abs(det(matrix))), preserving its rotation and handedness while substituting the forbidden scalar scale
coordinate_controls.zero_shifts: set all released ra_shift and dec_shift values to exactly zero
coordinate_controls.swap_F555W_F814W_coordinate_maps: exchange the complete five-field coordinate maps (ra_at_xy_0, dec_at_xy_0, transform_pix2angle, ra_shift, dec_shift) between F555W and F814W while leaving their images, exposure maps, noise, masks, PSFs, and numerics in place
coordinate_controls.comparison: sum heldout chi-square over all six sector fits and three bands
coordinate_controls.requirement: every corruption must have a strictly larger aggregate heldout chi-square than the released mapping by at least the frozen numerical floor

decision.advance: all full-mask and sector predictive thresholds pass and every coordinate corruption is detected; authorize only the already-frozen lens-response Jacobian
decision.fail: any predictive or coordinate-identification failure stops J1402 lens promotion; do not tune sectors, masks, thresholds, coordinates, or nonlinear parameters
